notes:
Recent evaluation focused on RAG for physician-facing search. Heavy PHI sensitivity; they stressed: 'audit trails for every token-level access' and 'no uncontrolled egress.'
- Use-case: clinicians + coding team using search + rerank to find prior notes and guideline snippets. Also retrospective cohort discovery for research (de-identified pipeline later).
- Indexing: plan to onboard ~50M docs across multiple EHR silos; ingestion will include metadata (patient id, encounter id) which must be masked in hosted test.
- Technical ask: embeddings computed on private infra or within VPC; reranker can be hosted if audit logs + VPC peering available. They prefer private control plane + customer-managed keys.
- Performance: they want p50 <150ms for search+rerank for live clinician flows, and throughput ~100qps sustained. Cost target <$0.02/query. Asked about batching, prefix caching, and incremental re-embedding strategy.
- Security: SOC2 + HIPAA required; BAA must be executed before any PHI access. Strong preference for KMS + HSM integration and immutable audit logs with 7+ years retention for some flows.
- Networking: private peering or AWS Transit requirement; egress rules audited by their network team.
- Data handling: retention policies differ by dataset, need per-index retention toggles and redaction hooks on ingest.
- Quote from CISO: 'We will not allow any model or tokenization step outside our VPC without an auditable exception.'
- Procurement timeline: internal budget review in April; forecast recommended close May 2026 if POC successful.
- Open items: BAA draft, network diagram, sample dataset redaction checklist, cost amortization model for reranking.
- Attached stubs: pricing deck (drive link), security questionnaire (drive link), Fireflies transcript id above, Jira tickets for infra questions.
- Sales notes: they shortened demo to focus on reranker latency; SE noted potential optimizations: KV cache retention per patient, cross-encoder rerank only for top-100 hits, try 8-bit quantized reranker to hit latency and cost targets.
use_case_summary: Enterprise RAG for clinical documentation: embeddings-based retrieval at large scale + neural reranker for precision. Primary consumers are clinicians and coding auditors; must preserve PHI controls, offer private networking and detailed auditability.
po_notes: Expect 6-week POC to validate indexing throughput, embedding pipeline in VPC, and reranker latency. SOW to include support hours for data onboarding and security review. Procurement asks for itemized cost per query with assumptions.
